epics.sixSigmaMetric: First pass yield for self-falsification audit resolution
requirements: R1: Explicitly handle error patterns for negative scenarios to satisfy BARCAN-TAG-07 refusal criteria.
R2: Update the API to return 201 Created instead of 200 OK to satisfy the 10 failing tests.
R3: Repair DossierTelemetryVerificationTest and FrontendBackendIntegrationE2ETest to resolve specification coverage gaps.

slices.title: Resolve API response codes and repair tests
slices.jtbd: When implementing the test repairs for this epic, I want to fix the API response codes, handle errors correctly, and fix the E2E tests, so that the CI pipeline passes without inventing adjacent scope
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthorized or invalid request, When the API processes it, Then it safely handles the negative scenario.
Given a successful resource creation request, When the API responds, Then it returns a 201 Created response instead of 200 OK.
Given the E2E and telemetry tests are executed, When they run against the system, Then they pass successfully.
slices.definitionOfDone: Implementation securely handles attack vectors through negative scenarios, explicitly managing 400, 401, 403, or error responses.
